methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google incubator represents concentrated institutional investment creating deep capability in Hampton Roads, but the incubator model serves select participants rather than distributing AI fluency across the region's broader workforce.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA explicitly targets community-wide education and innovation, signaling intentional distribution strategy that could build peer-to-peer learning networks beyond traditional tech concentrations.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia represents grassroots capacity-building in a historically underserved region, testing whether deep skills can emerge through distributed local networks rather than metro hub diffusion.

signals.title: Healthcare providers say AI helps them focus on patients. But it also raises questions about privacy, security and the role of humans in medicine
signals.signal_reading: Four in five doctors using AI for note-taking and communication exemplifies shallow, platform-delivered adoption—widespread use but limited understanding of underlying systems, raising questions about dependency versus capability-building in rural healthcare settings.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA intensifies the region's defense-AI cluster advantage, deepening specialized capabilities but concentrating talent and capital in already-dominant corridors.
